The company's employee performance review process at TechNova Solutions Pvt. Ltd. involves the following:

1. Bi-annual reviews: Performance appraisals are conducted twice a year, in June and December.
2. Objective and Key Results (OKR) framework: The reviews are based on the OKR framework, focusing on employee growth, skill development, and alignment with company goals.
3. Constructive reviews: The reviews are designed to be constructive, aiming to improve employee performance and growth.
4. Promotions, salary increments, and performance bonuses: These are tied to the December review cycle.
5. Regular 1-on-1 feedback sessions: Managers are encouraged to hold regular feedback sessions with employees to discuss their performance and growth.

Code of Conduct
The TechNova Code of Conduct mandates that all employees behave in a
professional, respectful, and ethical manner at all times. We have a zero-tolerance
policy for workplace harassment, discrimination, and bullying.
Employees must avoid any conflicts of interest and act in the best interests of the
company. Any violation of this code, whether in the office, during remote work, or at
company-sponsored events, will be met with strict disciplinary action, up to and
including termination of employment.
